description:
Eliud Ibarra-Kowalczyk-Mwangi is lean and angular, all sharp edges and visible tension. At 31, the augmentation scarring around her temples and jawline tells a story of installation by someone who prioritized function over aesthetics. The chrome is visible â€” vocal modulator â€” can replicate any voice after 30 seconds of sample audio â€” and she makes no effort to hide it.

She came up through the Gray Zone's informal apprentice system, learning the trade from runners who didn't survive long enough to see her surpass them. She works as a tech retriever out of Old Harbor, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

What Eliud Ibarra-Kowalczyk-Mwangi lacks in subtlety, she compensates for in thoroughness. No loose ends, no unfinished business, no second chances.

core_fears: Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
That the work they do makes the city worse, not better
Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
core_desires: The perfect run â€” one job so clean it becomes legend
A crew worth trusting â€” people who stay when the shooting starts
Knowledge â€” to understand the systems that grind people down
coping_mechanisms: Violence â€” hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Compartmentalization â€” work feelings and personal feelings exist in separate boxes
Maintains weapons obsessively â€” cleaning guns is meditation
blind_spots: Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
Trusts technology more than people â€” machines don't betray

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Old-fashioned formal diction â€” sounds like they learned to speak from pre-collapse recordings.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense â€” information-heavy sentences that demand attention.

Pauses mid-sentence to listen â€” combat habit that bleeds into conversation
example_lines: "Corporate R&D security is built to stop amateurs. I'm a professional."
"The prototype is worth more than both our lives combined. Handle it carefully."
"I steal things that haven't been invented yet. The future is always in transit."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Nurlan Morita-Antwi a permanent position â€” the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
Nurlan Morita-Antwi's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field â€” sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
A dead drop Nurlan Morita-Antwi maintains is found and cleaned out â€” whoever did it now has leverage
narrative_function: Nurlan Morita-Antwi represents the working professional of the runner world â€” competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Her stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Vocal modulator â€” can replicate any voice after 30 seconds of sample audio. Thermal masking system â€” body heat signature can be suppressed or spoofed
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure â€” wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.

weaknesses: risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities

decision_rules: Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners â€” checks it religiously
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified â€” being set up violates the contract
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess â€” read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate â€” try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate â€” make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence â€” surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement â€” overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol â€” abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
habits: Counts ammunition obsessively â€” knows the exact round count at all times
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
breaking_points: Complete isolation â€” cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously
Being forced to choose between a crew member and the mission â€” and choosing wrong

physical_description.heritage: Complex diaspora blend: Sub-Saharan African (32.7%) provides deep warm brown skin tone and fuller lip structure; Middle Eastern (29.3%) contributes defined facial geometry and distinctive eye shape; Eastern European (20.4%) sharpens cheekbones and introduces cool ashy undertones; Hispanic/Latin American (14.3%) rounds the nasal bridge and adds dimensional warmth; Central Asian (3.3%) traces subtly in eye placement and orbital geometry. The synthesis creates striking angular geometry with rich dimensional depth â€” a warm deep brown base suffused with cool ashy undertones, high sharp cheekbones balanced against fuller lips, broad nasal bridge with defined mandible, and almond-shaped eyes set with slight upward cant.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with visible musculature â€” swimmer's shoulders, minimal body fat. Every movement suggests coiled efficiency rather than relaxation.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with steel-grey undertones from repeated thermal stress near augmentation sites
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid; no ornament, no wasted length
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown â€” unaugmented, but the stare is unnerving; pupils track with unnatural precision
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm deep brown with subtle cool ashy undertones â€” dimensional blend creating complex depth and faint chromatic shimmer from thermal masking implant cycling
physical_description.complexion: High sharp cheekbones and defined mandible with angular geometry; broad nasal bridge with fuller lips characteristic of Sub-Saharan and Hispanic heritage; almond-shaped eyes with slight upward cant from Middle Eastern and Central Asian ancestry; clear skin marked by augmentation scarring. Fine surgical lines visible along temples and jawline where vocal modulator and thermal masking array were installed; chrome glints faintly beneath skin at these sites. Minimal grooming beyond function â€” no jewelry, no makeup. Face reads as intentionally unremarkable except for the chrome.
distinguishing_marks: Augmentation scarring along both temples â€” thin, precise surgical lines with faint chrome micro-etching visible beneath the skin surface
Vocal modulator chrome visible at the base of the jaw, silver-grey and industrial, no attempt at cosmetic concealment
Thin burn scar running along the inside of her left forearm â€” old and pale, consistent with thermal equipment failure
A small, deliberate knife scar on her right palm â€” pale and precise, possibly a ritual or debt marker
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Vocal modulator: visible chrome hardware along the jawline and throat, industrial appearance with no aesthetic softening. Thermal masking system: no visible hardware, but skin around her core occasionally shows faint chromatic distortion when the system activates or cycles. The effect is subtle â€” a shimmer like heat haze, visible only when she's stationary.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and controlled â€” no wasted motion. She moves like someone counting calories in every gesture. Stands with weight balanced, shoulders slightly forward. When idle, there is visible tension in her hands â€” fingers flex and reset as if running through muscle memory or code. Her gaze is steady and seldom breaks eye contact; it reads as threat assessment rather than politeness.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian black â€” fitted Kevlar-blend cargo pants with redundant pockets, black thermal-reactive jacket with concealed weapon mounts, unmarked steel-toed boots broken in past comfort into pure function. Everything is matte black or charcoal to reduce thermal signature. No visible branding except for a faded Lattice territory marker on her jacket cuff â€” a small embroidered cipher, her affiliation token. She wears minimalist jewelry: a single silver band on her right ring finger (purpose unclear â€” possibly a memento, possibly functional).
